items.prompt: Which of these is a repeating pattern?  (in this lesson: Pattern Path)
items.explanation: A, B, A, B repeats the same group again and again. The number lists grow instead of repeating.

items.prompt: Which of these is an increasing pattern?  (in this lesson: Pattern Path)
items.explanation: Each number grows by 5: 5, 10, 15, 20 is an increasing pattern.

items.prompt: What comes next: circle, star, circle, star, ___?
items.explanation: The pattern repeats circle, star. After star comes circle again.
